principles: Finding property does not automatically transfer ownership.
Rescue of living people takes priority over property claims.
Salvage rights depend on jurisdiction, abandonment, contract, registry and prior ownership.
A salvage notice preserves evidence; it does not itself prove title.

claim_types.description: Compensation for saving a vessel or cargo whose owner retains title.
Owner or insurer hires a salvor under agreed terms.
Claim filed on apparently abandoned property; title remains pending.
Authority pays or authorizes removal of dangerous wreckage.
Insurer that paid a total loss may own or control recovery rights.
Lender can retain interest in a financed vessel even after abandonment by operator.

frontier_rule: Beyond effective jurisdiction, possession can be easy and clean title can be difficult. Bringing an undocumented recovered ship back into reputable commerce exposes the title problem.
